- [Companies](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/companies.md): Endpoints for the companies resource. Companies can have multiple addresses (see Addresses API; filter with companyId.eq). Company notes are managed via POST /1.0/companies/{companyId}/add-notes or included on create/update.
- [Get company by Id](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/get-company.md)
- [Update company by Id](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/update-company.md)
- [Delete company by Id](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/delete-company.md)
- [Create a note for a company](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/create-company-note.md): Creates a note on a NOTE-type custom field for a company.
- [Get all companies](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/get-all-companies.md): This endpoint can be used to search for companies. The response body is paginated and you can control the pagination using the `pageSize` and `pageToken` parameters. Native filters include companyName, companyUrl, and accountOwner. Custom company fields (including NOTE fields, treated as text) can be filtered with `company.field.<custom_field_id>.operator=value`.
- [Create a company](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/create-company.md)

- [Fields](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/fields.md)
- [Get field by Id](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/get-field.md)
- [Update field by Id](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/update-field.md)
- [Delete field by Id](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/delete-field.md)
- [Update field Option](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/update-field-option.md): Update an option on a `SINGLE_CHOICE` or `MULTIPLE_CHOICE` field, or a tag on a `NOTE` field. For NOTE fields, tags are exposed and updated via fieldOptions.
- [Add field Option](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/add-field-option.md): Add an option to a `SINGLE_CHOICE` or `MULTIPLE_CHOICE` field, or a tag to a `NOTE` field. For NOTE fields, the option is stored as a tag and returned as a fieldOption.
- [Get all fields](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/get-all-fields.md)
- [Create a Field](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/create-field.md): Create a custom field for PROJECT, TASK, USER, or COMPANY object types. fieldType NOTE is allowed for PROJECT and COMPANY. For NOTE fields, optional fieldOptions are stored as tags.
- [Get a time entry](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/get-time-entry.md): This endpoint can be used to get a time entry using its ID. This API returns the time entry object that matches the ID. The `includeFields` param can be used to customise the response.
- [Update a time entry](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/update-time-entry.md): This endpoint can be used to update a time entry using its ID. To ensure that the total time for all the time entries added for that date does not exceed 24 hours, the fields `date` and `minutes` are mandatory. The properties `activityName`, `notes`, `billable` and `minutes` can be updated using this endPoint. This API returns the updated time entry object.
- [Delete a time entry](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/delete-time-entry.md): This endpoint can be used to delete a time entry using its ID. Upon successful deletion, _`HTTP status 204` - no content_ is returned as a response with no response body.
- [Get all time entries](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/get-all-time-entries.md): This endpoint can be used to get all time entries. You can refine your search by adding filters. Filters are given as query parameters and have a defined structure: key is `field.operator` and value is `value`. For instance: `date.gt=2023-02-11`, `minutes.eq=250`. Apart from filters, you can add `sortBy` combined with `sortOrder` to sort the time entries. The response body is paginated and you can control the pagination using the `limit` and `pageToken` parameters.
- [Create a time entry](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/create-time-entry.md): This endpoint can be used to create a time entry. It is mandatory to provide values for these three properties: `date`, `minutes` and the source of the time entry, which can be either one of `activityName`, `task`, `projectPhase` or `project`. The `activityName` param can be used to track time against adhoc activities. Providing multiple sources as input will result in an error. This API returns the created time entry object.
- [Search time entries](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/search-time-entries.md): This endpoint can be used to search for time entries. You can refine your search by adding filters. Filters are given as query parameters and have a defined structure: key is `field.operator` and value is `value`. For instance: `date.gt=2023-02-11`, `minutes.eq=250`. Apart from filters, you can add `sortBy` combined with `sortOrder` to sort the time entries. The response body is paginated and you can control the pagination using the `limit` and `pageToken` parameters.
- [Get time entry categories](https://developer.rocketlane.com/reference/get-time-entry-categories.md): This endpoint can be used to fetch the time entry categories. This API returns a paginated object containing the various time entry categories present.
